name: mutL homolog 3

function.text: MLH3 encodes DNA mismatch repair protein Mlh3. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and ATP-dependent DNA damage sensor activity. It participates in mismatch repair and reciprocal meiotic recombination.
